spelljammer.rule.orb-illumination-remova.blocked_reason: The object changes state when removed from its socket.

spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.name: Spelljamming helm stabilization

effect.summary: Projecting a magic circle or hexagon stabilizes a floating helm while allowing it to swivel.

spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.cost_or_limit: The projected shape holds the helm in place.
spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.who_may: Applies to the described ship helms
spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.where_from: The Moondancer and Dark Star helms
spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.combines: The helm is used by a spelljammer to pilot the ship.
spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.mechanism: A projected field anchors a floating device.
spelljammer.rule.spelljamming-helm-stabi.blocked_reason: The helm's stabilizing projection is a field that holds an object in place.

spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.name: Jolly boats

effect.summary: Jolly boats use oars in a larger body’s gravity plane and become uncontrollable without one.

spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.cost_or_limit: One crew member has enough air for 8 hours, or four have enough for 2 hours each.
spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.go_wrong: Without a gravity plane, the boat cannot be controlled.
spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.combines: Boats can cross between intersecting gravity planes and air envelopes.
spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.mechanism: Gravity-plane flotation and limited air supply.
spelljammer.rule.jolly-boats.blocked_reason: The movement and air limits are expressible.

spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-hiring-and-.name: Spelljammer hiring and payment terms

effect.summary: Fel may demand a 1,000 gp fee or accept 25 percent of found treasure until paid.

spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-hiring-and-.cost_or_limit: A 400 gp lease refund and potentially 3,000 gp for lost revenue are also negotiated.
spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-hiring-and-.go_wrong: A failed negotiation can leave Fel unwilling to cooperate.
spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-hiring-and-.blocked_reason: The terms are ordinary game costs and conditions.

spelljammer.rule.air-envelopes.name: Air envelopes

effect.summary: The remaining ship envelope can sustain survivors for eight hours, or debris may provide only an hour or two of breathable air.

spelljammer.rule.air-envelopes.cost_or_limit: Available air duration depends on the remaining envelope and situation.
spelljammer.rule.air-envelopes.who_may: Creatures relying on an air envelope.
spelljammer.rule.air-envelopes.combines: Applies to ships and debris in Wildspace.
spelljammer.rule.air-envelopes.blocked_reason: The stated duration limit can be tracked directly.

spelljammer.rule.pirate-code.name: Pirate Code

effect.summary: Gargenhale’s crew must not consume one another, sing holy hymns aboard, abandon duties, or fight aboard ship.

spelljammer.rule.pirate-code.cost_or_limit: Offenders who abandon posts or shirk duties are marooned; disputes must be settled ashore.
spelljammer.rule.pirate-code.go_wrong: Breaking the code can result in punishment or crew conflict.
spelljammer.rule.pirate-code.combines: Sets rules for life aboard the fleet.
spelljammer.rule.pirate-code.blocked_reason: The rules are direct conditions and consequences.

spelljammer.rule.agony-s-bond-to-the-las.name: Agony’s bond to the Last Breath

effect.summary: Agony reforms aboard the ship after a day if reduced to zero hit points while the ship survives, and returns to the hold if it moves over 100 feet away.

spelljammer.rule.agony-s-bond-to-the-las.cost_or_limit: The Last Breath must have at least 1 hit point; the ghost is tethered within 100 feet.
spelljammer.rule.agony-s-bond-to-the-las.go_wrong: The ghost cannot be permanently slain while the ship survives.
spelljammer.rule.agony-s-bond-to-the-las.combines: Can teleport back to the ship as a bonus action while away.
spelljammer.rule.agony-s-bond-to-the-las.blocked_reason: The ghost’s persistence, reformation, and return require soul-state and binding mechanics.

spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-ship-invisi.name: Spelljammer ship invisibility

effect.summary: Gargenhale makes the Second Wind invisible to help it pursue the Last Breath.

spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-ship-invisi.cost_or_limit: Duration and other limitations are not given here.
spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-ship-invisi.who_may: Gargenhale uses the ship’s Ship Invisibility action.
spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-ship-invisi.combines: Conceals the Second Wind and crew from the Last Breath.
spelljammer.rule.spelljammer-ship-invisi.blocked_reason: The effect conceals an entire ship and its crew as a field.

spelljammer.rule.alchemist-s-fire-hold-e.name: Alchemist's-fire hold explosion

effect.summary: A hold fire burning for one minute ignites the remaining kegs and explodes the ship.

spelljammer.rule.alchemist-s-fire-hold-e.cost_or_limit: Anyone or anything within 100 feet takes 20d10 fire damage.
spelljammer.rule.alchemist-s-fire-hold-e.combines: Requires the fire to burn for one minute.
spelljammer.rule.alchemist-s-fire-hold-e.blocked_reason: A timed trigger and area damage can be represented by the basic effect grammar.

spelljammer.rule.doomspace-s-origin.name: Doomspace's origin

effect.summary: Gods were banished, primordials enclosed the system in a crystal sphere, and the sphere later shattered.

spelljammer.rule.doomspace-s-origin.cost_or_limit: The reason the gods shattered the sphere is unknown.
spelljammer.rule.doomspace-s-origin.combines: The sphere's destruction left outer crystal shards.
spelljammer.rule.doomspace-s-origin.blocked_reason: This is a setting mechanism rather than a character effect.

spelljammer.rule.astral-font.name: Astral Font

effect.summary: The pool’s light beam teleports creatures to Xaryxis, and its water can grant a temporary spell.

spelljammer.rule.astral-font.cost_or_limit: The spell-granting water works at most once per creature every 24 hours; only one granted spell can be held at once.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.go_wrong: Drinking water can inflict psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.mind: The failed save causes psychic damage; a successfully granted spell fades from memory once cast.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.who_may: Creatures in the beam or spellcasters drinking the water.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.combines: The beam transports creatures to Xaryxis’s core, where they take radiant damage; the zodar is immune.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.mechanism: Teleportation hazard and consumable spell grant with a saving throw, duration, and capacity limit.
spelljammer.rule.astral-font.blocked_reason: It combines a beam-triggered teleport with a creature-specific immunity and a saving-throw-based spell grant.

spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.name: Royal ring and Xaryxis

effect.summary: A royal ring thrown into Xaryxis’s heart destroys the star and system and ends the crystal-vine threat to the characters’ world.

spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.cost_or_limit: At least one of Xedalli’s or Xeleth’s rings must be obtained.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.go_wrong: Destroying the star also destroys everything in Xaryxispace.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.who_may: Anyone possessing a royal ring can carry out the act.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.where_from: The rings were forged in Xaryxis.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.combines: The zodar reveals the action as the way to save the characters’ world.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.mechanism: A ring-triggered star-destruction event with system-wide consequences.
spelljammer.rule.royal-ring-and-xaryxis.blocked_reason: The rule requires an item to trigger destruction of a star and a separate distant-world effect.

spelljammer.rule.no-coming-back.name: No coming back

effect.summary: A journey into Xaryxis's heart is fatal and cannot be reversed.

spelljammer.rule.no-coming-back.go_wrong: The traveler is consumed by the star.
spelljammer.rule.no-coming-back.combines: The journey may be made by ship or through the Astral Font's light beam.
spelljammer.rule.no-coming-back.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot represent a guaranteed, irreversible death state.

spelljammer.rule.destroying-xaryxis.name: Destroying Xaryxis

effect.summary: A bearer of Xeleth's or Xedalli's ring must enter the star's heart to destroy it.

spelljammer.rule.destroying-xaryxis.cost_or_limit: The bearer must make a fatal journey, by ship or the Astral Font's beam.
spelljammer.rule.destroying-xaryxis.combines: The ring and entry into the star's heart are both required.

spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.name: Xaryxispace shock waves

effect.summary: Xaryxis's collapse sends waves that destroy everything in Xaryxispace but do not reach the Astral Sea.

spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.cost_or_limit: The waves affect Xaryxispace, not the Astral Sea; ships have time to escape.
spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.go_wrong: Anything caught in Xaryxispace is destroyed.
spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.combines: A ship's spelljamming helm can help characters escape to the Astral Sea.
spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.mechanism: area destruction with a spatial boundary
spelljammer.rule.xaryxispace-shock-waves.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot express a destructive field bounded by a region.

spelljammer.rule.xaryxis-and-the-charact.name: Xaryxis and the characters' world

effect.summary: The characters' world is bound to Xaryxis's fate; if the star remains, the world faces annihilation.

spelljammer.rule.xaryxis-and-the-charact.go_wrong: The world begins to fracture if Xaryxis is spared.
spelljammer.rule.xaryxis-and-the-charact.combines: Destroying Xaryxis ends the crystal-vine threat to the world.

spelljammer.rule.xeleth-and-xedalli-s-cl.name: Xeleth and Xedalli's clones

effect.summary: Each sibling has one clone, so at least one may survive the adventure.

spelljammer.rule.xeleth-and-xedalli-s-cl.go_wrong: A surviving sibling may seek revenge.
spelljammer.rule.xeleth-and-xedalli-s-cl.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar cannot represent clone-based survival or backup states.
